Module com.example.miniproyecto3_battleship
Package com.example.miniproyecto3_battleship.model.Game

Class Game

java.lang.Object
com.example.miniproyecto3_battleship.model.Game.Game
All Implemented Interfaces:
IGame, Serializable
public class Game extends Object implements IGame
Represents the core logic of the Battleship game, managing players, ships, and gameplay operations. Implements the IGame interface.

This class handles player interactions, ship management, and game rules such as determining the winner.

Players include a bot (PlayerBot) and a human player (PlayerPerson). Ship configurations are stored and manipulated using a list of positions.

Author:
Juan David Lopez Vanegas
